summary: Phase 3 CodeCamp Runtime Reliability is complete. All targeted Phase 3 tests (domain TenantDB runtime, domain webhook idempotency, webhooks idempotency + timestamp-poison guard, webhooks ACK latency, codecamp streaming-protocol) pass. TenantScopeError is eliminated on CodeCamp REFERENTIAL tables via greppable unscoped('reason') calls. GitHub webhook is idempotent by delivery-id (two-layer: in-process Set + SELECT-before-INSERT) and ACKs before running the LLM review (tracked in backgroundReviewJobs Map, drainable via waitForBackgroundReviews). The chat route now emits text/event-stream that the useChatStream client parser accepts. The two corrected Red tests (idempotency, ACK-latency) are sound and not weakened: the idempotency test still requires webhookPathExecutedCount=1 (fails on zero execution), and the ACK test snapshots reviewResolvedWhenAcked at the exact moment the ACK wins the race before the finally block resolves the deferred review. Closeout aggregates: @reading-advantage/domain 353 passed 5 skipped, @reading-advantage/api 216 passed, @reading-advantage/webhooks 82 passed, codecamp-advantage 954 passed 64 skipped 47 failed — every codecamp failure is a pre-existing live-network prod-smoke test in lib/__tests__/prod-smoke/phase-*.test.ts or the pre-existing artifact test lib/__tests__/thai-text-width.test.ts (verified to also fail at baseline SHA 7ff3a8f8 with the exact same 5/8 failure profile). Codecamp check-types TS2307 'Cannot find module @reading-advantage/ai' is pre-existing: the import chain in apps/codecamp-advantage/app/api/chat/route.ts already imported @reading-advantage/ai at baseline SHA b8e3b5d5 (verified via git show), and Phase 3 did not add the import.

nonblocking_findings.description: Plan Phase 3 closeout aggregate cites codecamp-advantage as '944 passed 64 skipped 57 failed'. My independent run reports '954 passed 64 skipped 47 failed'. The delta is entirely inside the pre-existing prod-smoke suite whose results depend on live-network reachability of https://codecamp.reading-advantage.com. The plan already documents these as pre-existing flaky live-network tests owned by the prod-smoke workstream, and no Wave 1 code paths are affected. Not blocking Phase 3 acceptance because (a) the qualitative claim (all failures pre-existing prod-smoke or artifact tests) is verified, (b) no phase task exit-code claim is falsified — targeted Phase 3 gate exits 0, and (c) the delta reflects a flaky network probe, not fabricated evidence.

Would still fail against non-idempotent handler (count>1).
corrected_test_soundness.github-webhook-ack-latency.test.ts: SOUND — original expect(reviewResolved).toBe(false) after finally set it true (unsatisfiable) rewritten to snapshot reviewResolvedWhenAcked at race resolution (before finally). Timeout Promise.race rejects with 'ACK blocked by LLM review' after 500ms if ACK cannot return without awaiting LLM. Not weakened — still asserts (a) ack wins race and (b) LLM review promise unresolved at ACK time.
